description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Microsoft develops cloud-based enterprise services, and its Intune team provides tools for managing productivity, security, endpoints, and corporate data across multiple platforms. The Software Engineer will design, build, and manage highly scalable cloud service features, develop backend microservices and frontend interfaces, debug and optimize across services, and own scenarios that improve customer experience and simplify administrative tasks.
Software engineer building cloud-based endpoint management services, backend microservices, and administrative interfaces

Responsibilities:
• Be a part of a team of dedicated professionals who works on critical and strategic projects within Intune
• Works on projects that requires engineers capable of delivering robust designs and code across both backend microservices and frontend interfaces
• Operates effectively in a dynamic agile environment, requiring proficiency in debugging and optimizing tasks across multiple services and teams
• Places a high value on collaboration, customer focus, and an open culture that strives for success in both technology and people
• Designs, builds, and manages cloud service features at high scale and availability
• Have end-to-end ownership of scenarios that directly impact customer experience and facilitate the simplification of administrative tasks

Requirements:
• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python
  + OR equivalent experience
• Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role

Preferred:
• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, or related technical field AND 1+ year(s) technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Rust, or Python.
  + OR Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field with proven experience coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Rust, or Python.
  + OR equivalent experience
• Strong coding, debugging, and problem-solving skills
• Great communication skills to collaborate across groups and work effectively within the team
• Expertise in distributed systems and/or big data technologies
• Experience in developing large scale online services, mobile and desktop platforms
